title: FRAGILE GIANTS: UNDERSTANDING THE SUSCEPTIBILITY OF MODELS TO SUBPOPULATION ATTACKS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the target damage (accuracy drop) caused by label-flipping subpopulation poisoning attacks on subgroups defined by gender and gender identity annotations (e.g., male, female, transgender) in the Adult and CivilComments datasets.

Evaluating the susceptibility to poisoning attacks by measuring accuracy degradation on subgroups defined by race, ethnicity, or skin tone annotations (e.g., black, white, pale skin, dark skin) in the Adult, CelebA, and CivilComments datasets.
Assessing the target damage from subpopulation poisoning attacks on groups defined by religious affiliations (e.g., Christian, Muslim, Hindu, Buddhist, Jewish, atheist) in the CivilComments dataset.
Measuring the vulnerability to poisoning attacks (target damage) on subpopulations defined by sexual orientation (e.g., homosexual/gay/lesbian, bisexual, LGBTQ) in the CivilComments dataset.
Evaluating the accuracy drop on age-defined subgroups (e.g., young, old) when subjected to label-flipping poisoning attacks in the CelebA dataset.
Measuring susceptibility to subpopulation poisoning attacks on subgroups defined by education levels in the Adult dataset.
Evaluating the target damage from poisoning attacks on subpopulations defined by physical traits (e.g., hair color, chubbiness, presence of a beard) in the CelebA dataset.
